explain_en: 무겁다 is ㅂ-irregular: 무거워요, 무거웠어요. The opposite is 가볍다. It is also used for a heavy body, heart or mood.

examples.en: This bag is very light.

examples.ko: 가방이 아주 가벼워요. 안에 아무것도 없어요.
examples.en: The bag is very light. There's nothing in it.
These sneakers are light and comfortable.
This jacket is light. I wear it in winter too.
Is this chair heavy? — No, it’s light.

explain: 가볍다도 ㅂ 불규칙이에요: 가벼워요. 무게뿐 아니라 ‘부담이 적다’는 뜻도 있어요. 그래서 ‘가벼운 식사’라고도 해요.

phrases.example: 입이 가벼운 사람한테는 비밀을 말하지 마세요.

explain_en: 가볍다 is also ㅂ-irregular (가벼워요). Besides weight it means “not burdensome”, which is why you hear 가벼운 식사 (a light meal).

examples.en: My heart ached when I saw the news.
I really like this bag.

examples.en: I’ve made up my mind. I’m going to Korea next month.

explain: 마음은 몸의 심장이 아니에요. 생각과 느낌이 있는 속마음이에요. 몸의 심장은 ‘심장’이라고 해요.

explain_en: 마음 is not the physical heart. It is the inner heart where thoughts and feelings live. The organ is called 심장.

dis.h: feelings or mind inside a person

p.n: 마음 means emotional pain; 심장 means the organ hurts.
